name: task-e3-a0-v1-1000-cpu-counter
longtaskNote: Observer entries cover the diagnostic page, including oracle and instrumentation work. They are not isolated engine windows or formal user-latency samples; initialization visibility depends on each mode's explicit mark reset.

gc.note: Recorded GC categories nest; only the union of same-main-thread intervals is additive. This is instrumented GC-category time, not a claim that every event is a stop-the-world pause. These diagnostic runs cannot attribute every formal slow sample to GC.

sampleOrdering.policy: All raw deltas decoded from profile.startTime; timestamp/node pairs sorted together. Each sample receives the preceding chronological interval, clipped to marked windows. No sample removal or fabricated missing samples; raw profiles unchanged.

cpu.note: 1ms weighted samples are approximate; inclusive stacks overlap and cannot be summed. Initialization includes its real timer wait. Primary windows include dispatch-helper target lookup for counter/move/delete/add and setter lookup for dirty; they exclude semantic oracle and async follow-up. Follow-up work remains in the complete raw profile. Distinguish adapter frames from engine frames.

allocations.note: Poisson allocation sampling includes subsequently collected objects. Entire diagnostic, including initialization and oracle. See call stacks to distinguish engine from oracle; not an exact allocation count or a formal timing sample.
